answers.question: Which stores are growing fastest vs last year?
answers.title: Revenue growth vs last year, last 90 days
answers.sql: SELECT s.name || ', ' || s.city AS store, ROUND(SUM(ds.revenue) FILTER(WHERE ds.sale_date > m.max_date - 90)) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(ds.revenue) FILTER(WHERE ds.sale_date BETWEEN m.max_date - 453 AND m.max_date - 364)) AS revenue_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(ds.revenue) FILTER(WHERE ds.sale_date > m.max_date - 90) / NULLIF(SUM(ds.revenue) FILTER(WHERE ds.sale_date BETWEEN m.max_date - 453 AND m.max_date - 364), 0) - 1), 1) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM daily_sales AS ds JOIN stores AS s ON s.id = ds.store_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX(sale_date) AS max_date FROM daily_sales) AS m GROUP BY s.name, s.city ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC LIMIT 200
answers.answer: Highest growth vs last year: Gachibowli, Hyderabad at +40.6%. Lowest: Baner, Pune at -11.0%.

answers.question: Why is Pune Baner's revenue falling?
answers.title: Pune Baner monthly revenue vs last year
answers.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ds.sale_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(ds.revenue) AS revenue FROM daily_sales AS ds JOIN stores AS s ON s.id = ds.store_id WHERE s.code = 'PUN01' GROUP BY 1) SELECT cur.month, ROUND(cur.revenue) AS revenue, ROUND(prev.revenue) AS revenue_last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (cur.revenue / prev.revenue - 1), 1) AS yoy_pct FROM monthly AS cur JOIN monthly AS prev ON prev.month = CAST((cur.month - INTERVAL '1 YEAR') AS DATE) WHERE cur.month BETWEEN CAST('2025-11-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) ORDER BY cur.month LIMIT 200
answers.answer: Below last year for 6 months in a row, since April 2026. The latest is -4.7% and the worst -8.6%, so this is a sustained drop rather than a one-off.

answers.question: Which SKUs will run out of stock before we can restock?
answers.title: Store x SKU combinations at stock-out risk
answers.sql: SELECT s.name || ', ' || s.city AS store, p.name AS product, i.on_hand, ROUND(CAST((f.units / 7.0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS daily_demand, ROUND(CAST((i.on_hand / NULLIF(f.units / 7.0, 0)) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS days_of_cover, p.lead_time_days FROM inventory AS i JOIN forecasts AS f ON f.store_id = i.store_id AND f.product_id = i.product_id AND f.week_start = (SELECT MIN(week_start) FROM forecasts) JOIN stores AS s ON s.id = i.store_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE i.on_hand / NULLIF(f.units / 7.0, 0) < p.lead_time_days ORDER BY days_of_cover LIMIT 20

answers.question: How much revenue came from promotions by category?
answers.title: Promotion revenue by category, last 90 days
answers.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ds.revenue) FILTER(WHERE ds.promo_discount > 0), 0)) AS promo_revenue, ROUND(SUM(ds.revenue)) AS total_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(ds.revenue) FILTER(WHERE ds.promo_discount > 0), 0) / SUM(ds.revenue), 1) AS promo_share_pct FROM daily_sales AS ds JOIN products AS p ON p.id = ds.product_id WHERE ds.sale_date > (SELECT MAX(sale_date) FROM daily_sales) - 90 GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY promo_revenue DESC LIMIT 200
answers.answer: Highest promo revenue: Snacks & Beverages at ₹2,263,076. Lowest: Festive & Gifting at ₹0.

answers.question: Which categories peaked in the run-up to Diwali 2025?
answers.title: Two weeks before Diwali 2025 vs a normal fortnight
answers.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(ds.revenue) FILTER(WHERE ds.sale_date BETWEEN CAST('2025-10-07' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-10-20' AS DATE))) AS diwali_fortnight, ROUND(SUM(ds.revenue) FILTER(WHERE ds.sale_date BETWEEN CAST('2025-09-09' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-09-22' AS DATE))) AS normal_fortnight, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(ds.revenue) FILTER(WHERE ds.sale_date BETWEEN CAST('2025-10-07' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-10-20' AS DATE)) / NULLIF(SUM(ds.revenue) FILTER(WHERE ds.sale_date BETWEEN CAST('2025-09-09' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-09-22' AS DATE)), 0) - 1), 1) AS uplift_pct FROM daily_sales AS ds JOIN products AS p ON p.id = ds.product_id WHERE ds.sale_date BETWEEN CAST('2025-09-09' AS DATE) AND CAST('2025-10-20' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY uplift_pct DESC LIMIT 200
answers.answer: Highest diwali fortnight: Staples at ₹3,375,887. Lowest: Home Care at ₹2,008,325.

answers.question: Why did Cola 2L sales dip in Mumbai in May 2026?
answers.title: Cola 2L daily units, Mumbai Andheri
answers.sql: SELECT ds.sale_date, ds.units, ROUND(ds.revenue) AS revenue FROM daily_sales AS ds JOIN stores AS s ON s.id = ds.store_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = ds.product_id WHERE s.code = 'MUM01' AND p.sku = 'SNB-003' AND ds.sale_date BETWEEN CAST('2026-04-20' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-06-14' AS DATE) ORDER BY ds.sale_date LIMIT 200
answers.answer: Units were zero for 14 days in a row, from 11 May 2026 to 24 May 2026, while the rest of the period kept selling. That pattern points to a stock-out.
